name: The Shadow Guard

guaranteedRewards.name: Shadow Guard
tooltip: Use: Permanently adds 10 shadow resistance to a leg or head slot item. Does not stack with other enchantments for the selected equipment slot.

statusNote: Changed in Forever. Pays -30g instead of 0. From Wowhead’s Forever database.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
A creation of genius! Much like the Ice Guard, the Shadow Guard employs a thin sheen of protective magic that covers certain pieces of equipment. And like the Ice Guard, the Shadow Guard is going to cost you a good amount of money.

<Mataus holds his hand out and rubs his fingers together.>

Interested?
narrative.objectives: Mataus the Wrathcaster at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants 10 Insignia of the Crusade and 30 gold.
narrative.offerRewardText: <Mataus stuffs the gold into his robe.>What are you still standing around for, friend? Our business is done.
narrative.requestItemsText: <Mataus yawns.>Be gone, insect, lest you have something for me.
